The '''Thalassians''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thalassia/Legends|Thalassia]]. Famous members included the [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]].
